title: A young adult East Asian woman stands in
prompt: A young adult East Asian woman stands in the open doorway of an old Chongqing noodle shop. She has fair skin, a slender figure, and long dark-brown hair with a near-center part and natural waves falling over her shoulders and chest. Her makeup is understated, her lips are pale pink, and she tilts her head slightly while looking directly into the camera with a faint smile. She wears a fitted white short-sleeved mini dress in fine ribbed knit, with a low neckline and small round front buttons, several of which are undone at the neckline. Her right hand, on the viewer’s left, pinches and lifts the hem at her right hip, creating diagonal folds and an asymmetric hemline that reveals pale gray-green lace-trim panties. Her left hand, on the viewer’s right, supports a white porcelain noodle bowl with a thin dark rim between chest and waist level. The bowl reads “重庆小面” and contains visible noodles, reddish-brown toppings, and bright green garnish. Her legs are lightly crossed, one knee bends slightly inward, and her feet rest close together in white lace-up low-top sneakers. Include her entire body from head to shoes. Use a vertical 3:4, straight-on full-body composition with an approximately eye-level viewpoint and natural perspective without obvious wide-angle stretching. Position her slightly right of center within the doorway, occupying about sixty percent of the image height. An enormous dark-brown, nearly black weathered wooden sign spans the top of the entrance, with its very top edge slightly cropped. Large cream brush-calligraphy characters read “重庆小面”; smaller text at the lower right reads “老城味道”, beside a small red seal. On the worn gray-white wall to the left, a blue address plaque bears the white text “临江路” and “28”, with the vertical black inscription “重庆是一座可以边吃边爱的城市” below it. The peeling reddish-brown doorpost on the right carries the vertical text “一碗小面也是重庆”. A blackboard menu leans beside the entrance at the lower left, and a reddish-brown menu hangs at the upper right. Both are titled “重庆小面” and list “牛肉小面 12元”, “豌杂小面 10元”, “酸辣小面 10元”, and “素小面 8元”. The bottom of the blackboard also reads “老重庆·老味道” in faded pink-red lettering. Beneath the upper-right menu, a cream illustrated panel reads “一碗小面” and “装下重庆人的江湖”, accompanied by gray-brown drawings of a bridge and old hillside buildings. The narrow shop recedes behind her, with aged cream walls, exposed pipes, two small warm-white hanging lights, and a black wall-mounted fan on the left. A dense mural of hillside architecture covers the interior left wall, beside the separate inscriptions “重庆，”, “不只是火锅”, and “还有小面”, with a small red heart. Several adult diners sit farther inside; a diner facing away wears a black shirt with “山城” on the back. On the left, a worn wooden table holds condiment bottles, a container of bamboo chopsticks, and metal seasoning canisters, surrounded by tightly arranged old wooden stools. On the right are a stained, worn metal preparation counter, cooking pots, and stacked bowls; the visible red lettering on the counter front reads “重庆味”. Preserve the old threshold and gray stone steps beneath her feet, a thin yellow line along the street edge, and heavily defocused dark-green metal railings in both lower corners. A blurred fragment of a dark vehicle enters along the right edge. Soft, diffused outdoor daylight illuminates her face, white clothing, and legs, while the interior remains darker with gently glowing warm lights and soft shadows. Use a subdued palette of reddish brown, deep brown, cream gray, and dark green, making her white clothing and fair skin the bright visual center. Maintain a natural, realistic street environmental-portrait photography aesthetic: fine, smooth skin, discernible knitted ribs, aged wood grain, and peeling paint; a clear subject without excessive sharpening; a slightly softened shop interior; strongly blurred foreground railings; and very little visible grain. Do not add poster-style lettering unrelated to the physical scene.
